Decide each pinned line again from the inputs it recorded. The exit code is the OR of 1 for a line that decides differently, 2 for one that cannot be decided again, and 4 on its own for an error

Usage: byrle audit verify --policy <POLICY> <LOG>

Arguments:
  <LOG>  The audit log. The files rotated from it are read too, oldest first

Options:
      --policy <POLICY>  A policy file a line may have been decided under, matched by digest
  -h, --help             Print help
